question: Can chronological inference distinguish a changed preference, execution skill or opportunity distribution without receiving the changed role or time?
scope: Initial exact supplied-law binary-role ruler. This distinct miniature tests state and transition assumptions, not a trained architecture or human stable values. Learned chronological models and the original-world extension remain conditional.
prefix_pairing: Every intervention uses the same 96-episode random coins and initial state within each world/stream. Both horizons read the same stream prefix at a fixed absolute change position. Positions 8/16/24 realize 25/50/75 percent of 32; 24/48/72 realize 25/50/75 percent of 96. Other cells explicitly include early, future or forecast-time changes; they are not silently relabeled. Repeated no-change positions are duplicate controls.
world: Three independent binary roles govern context-match preference, execution reliability and opportunity frequency. World-specific channel probabilities are drawn once in declared disjoint ranges and supplied equally to every reader. Observations are chronological opportunity and resulting artifact; intention and success remain evaluator-only. At most one role flips at the assigned position.
target: Seven bits: current preference, skill and opportunity states; next opportunity; intended action; execution success; artifact. Score full-target probabilities and each bit separately. A successful artifact is distinct from correctly recovered preference or skill.

readers.role-mixture: no change with prior .25, otherwise one uniformly located change among 95 gaps, flipping exactly one of three roles uniformly
readers.direct-chronological: same change-time prior but an unrestricted different successor among seven alternatives, marginalized over complete chronological states

privileges: All readers know the finite observation channel and state vocabulary. No true role, state, change time or evaluator label enters inference. The direct chronological rival has a richer transition family and different prior mass, not matched fitted capacity. No B/C headroom or law-marginal claim follows.
checks: Uninformative observations retain uniform current state
Nearly exact observations recover a known state
Scalar probability-domain channel/filter reference for every forecast
Static order invariance and dynamic order sensitivity
Full frozen scientific replay before acceptance
interpretation: Pair whole worlds, not streams or repeated controls. Report each reader's no-change-to-role-change contrast and predictive versus role recovery separately. No cloned reports occur; each episode enters once. Discovery is not confirmation. No new F03 category is claimed. Miniature — architecture untested. Stop scale-up if preference and skill attribution cannot be distinguished. No compute superiority claim from shared consumer timing.
